summary: Shows selecting a template per distribution with the first_found lookup over a list of candidate files and search paths, which is cleaner than many conditionals inside one template.
questions: How do I choose a config template per Linux distribution?
How does the first_found lookup work with templates?
How do I fall back to a default template?

answer_card.title: Selecting templates with first_found
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.template:
    src: "{{ item }}"
    dest: /etc/myapp/foo.conf
  loop: "{{ query('first_found', { 'files': myfiles, 'paths': mypaths}) }}"
  vars:
    myfiles:
      - "{{ ansible_facts['distribution'] }}.conf"
      - default.conf
    mypaths: ['search_location_one/somedir/', '/opt/other_location/somedir/']
```
